sn22.101:1.2: bhikkhave passato āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi no ajānato no apassato.
sn22.101:1.3: kiñca bhikkhave jānato kiṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn22.101:1.4: iti rūpaṃ iti rūpassa samudayo iti rūpassa atthaṅgamo
sn22.101:1.8: iti viññāṇaṃ iti viññāṇassa samudayo iti viññāṇassa atthaṅgamoti.
sn22.101:1.9: evaṃ kho bhikkhave jānato evaṃ passato āsavānaṃ khayo hoti.
sn22.101:2.1: bhāvanānuyogaṃ ananuyuttassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:2.2: aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti atha khvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn22.101:2.6: abhāvitattā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ abhāvitattā catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ balānaṃ abhāvitattā sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ abhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa.
sn22.101:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:3.2: tānassu kukkuṭiyā na sammāadhisayitāni na sammāpariseditāni na sammāparibhāvitāni
sn22.101:3.3: kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:3.4: aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyunti
sn22.101:3.5: atha kho abhabbāva te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ.
sn22.101:3.7: tathā hi pana bhikkhave kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā
sn22.101:3.8: tānassu kukkuṭiyā na sammāadhisayitāni na sammāpariseditāni na sammāparibhāvitāni.
sn22.101:3.9: evameva kho bhikkhave bhāvanāyuyogaṃ ananuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:3.10: aho vata me anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti atha khvassa neva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn22.101:3.14: abhāvitattā catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ abhāvitattā catunnaṃ sammappadhānānaṃ abhāvitattā catunnaṃ iddhipādānaṃ abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ abhāvitattā pañcannaṃ balānaṃ abhāvitattā sattannaṃ bojjhaṅgānaṃ abhāvitattā ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa.

sn22.101:5.3: kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya
sn22.101:5.4: aho vata me kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyunti

sn22.101:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave phalabhaṇḍassa vā phalabhaṇḍantevāsissa vā vāsijaṭe dissante vā aṅgulipadāni dissanti aṅguṭṭhapadā
sn22.101:6.2: no ca khvassa evamassa ñāṇaṃ hoti
sn22.101:6.3: ettakaṃ vā me ajja vāsijaṭassa khīṇaṃ ettakaṃ hiyyo ettakaṃ pareti
sn22.101:6.5: evameva kho bhikkhave bhāvanānuyogamanuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato kiñcāpi na evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti
sn22.101:6.6: ettakaṃ vā me ajja āsavānaṃ khīṇaṃ ettakaṃ hiyyo ettakaṃ pareti atha khvassa khīṇe khīṇanteva ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn22.101:6.7: seyyathāpi bhikkhave sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabandhāya chammāsāni udake pariyādāya hemantikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vātātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni tāni pavussakena meghena abhippavuṭṭhāni appakasireneva paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavanti.
sn22.101:6.8: evameva kho bhikkhave bhāvanānuyogamanuyuttassa bhikkhuno viharato appakasireneva saññojanāni paṭippassambhanti pūtikāni bhavantīti.
